name: Lightning
description: A former Guardian Corps soldier driven by determination and an iron will. She embarks on a desperate mission to save her sister Serah from a cruel fate.

name: Snow Villiers
description: An idealistic hero-wannabe and leader of NORA. His unshakeable optimism and love for Serah push him to fight no matter the odds.

name: Oerba Dia Vanille
description: A cheerful and optimistic girl hiding a painful secret. Her upbeat nature masks deep guilt and a burden she has carried for centuries.

name: Sazh Katzroy
description: A warm-hearted airship pilot and devoted father. He travels with a baby chocobo nesting in his afro and carries sorrow about his son Dajh.

name: Hope Estheim
description: A timid boy who lost his mother during the Purge. He channels his grief into resolve and gradually grows into a courageous leader.

name: Oerba Yun Fang
description: A fierce and direct warrior from Gran Pulse. Her loyalty to Vanille is absolute, and her combat prowess is matched only by her sharp wit.
